one_month_reasoning: Three scheduled events fall in the window: September monthly revenue on Oct 8 (TSMC calendar, src 28), 3Q26 results and 4Q guidance on Oct 15, and the FOMC on Oct 27-28. July+August revenue of NT$982B means a September at or even ~6% below August still lands at the top of the 3Q guide (src 4), and UBS already models 3Q ~$45.7B / 4Q ~$50.3B with GM ~67% (src 21), so the beat is expected; the swing factors are 4Q GM guidance (N2 dilution 3-4pt) and early 2027 capex commentary (UBS $90B, BofA $85B vs ~$75B consensus, src 21/22) which the market could read either way (bigger capex = demand visibility but lower FCF). Against the small post-beat drift, the 10y touched 5.33% on Oct 1, its highest since 2002 (src 24), and a Fed that hiked in September meets inside the window. Net: drift trimmed to ~+0.5% (from +0.8%) and sigma ~12.5% for the month (annual 40%/3.5 plus a modest earnings bump), lognormal.

fair_value.method: Blend of 19x Oct-2027 NTM EPS of ~$25.1/ADR (0.25 x FY27E $22.3 + 0.75 x FY28E $26.0) = ~$477 (70%) and a 2.8% FCF yield on FY27E FCF of ~$12.1/ADR (revenue ~$228B, OCF margin ~65%, capex ~$85B) = ~$432 (30%), giving ~$464.

Net margin ~52% on ~$228B revenue and 5.186B ADR-equivalents.

+17% on FY27: UBS raised 2028 capex to $105B (src 21) and CoWoS capacity to ~180kwpm for TSMC by end-2027 (src 25), implying continued ~20% revenue growth (Investment Case base case ~20% CAGR, src 16) with GM fading ~1-2pt on N2/overseas dilution.

Today $459.2 / $21.93 = 20.9x next-year EPS (src 26). Lowered from 19.5x in round 1 because the 10y touched 5.33% on Oct 1, highest since 2002 (src 24), and growth decelerates from ~35% to ~17% by the exit date; 18-19x is the community's Taiwan-risk-adjusted range (src 14, colour only), July fwd P/E was 29.4x on FY26 (src 7).

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: FY2027E revenue ~$228B x OCF margin ~65% = ~$148B, less capex ~$85B = FCF ~$63B = ~$12.1/ADR, capitalised at a 2.8% FCF yield.

inputs_detail.derivation: Taken at consensus (src 26), between my round-1 $214B (too low per supervisor) and UBS $240.7B (src 21); 2026 base ~$172B (1Q $35.9B + 2Q $40.2B + 3Q ~$46B + 4Q ~$50B; UBS FY26 $172.2B).

UBS $90B (raised from $80B, src 21), BofA $85B with market consensus ~$75B (src 22), Nenni $76-80B in July (src 23). I take $85B: the newest broker forecasts are rising (equipment inflation, advance payments, packaging), but consensus is still lower.
Net margin ~52% (2Q26 55.6% incl. one-off gains, src 2; GM ~67% per UBS, src 21) plus D&A ~12-13% of revenue; trimmed from 68% because the higher revenue base dilutes the D&A share.
Raised from 2.6%: with the 10y at ~5.24-5.33% (src 24) a peak-capex FCF yield should not compress; ~2.8% is about today's yield on consensus-revenue FY27 FCF at $459, i.e. no re-rating.

bear.story: AI capex digestion in 2027 (hyperscaler FCF negative except Microsoft, src 9) meets $85-105B TSMC capex and a depreciation wall; CoWoS/N3 tightness eases as capacity grows 60%+, GM falls to low 60s on N2/overseas dilution, and with 5%+ yields the multiple compresses to ~15x on ~$20 EPS. Includes a ~5% Taiwan blockade/crisis tail (Polymarket 13% invasion by end-2027 on $3.3M volume, which resolves after the horizon and overstates a wipeout) at ~$150-250.

base.story: Beat-and-raise continues: 3Q26 at the top of the guide, FY27 revenue ~+33% to ~$228B, EPS ~$22.3, NTM EPS ~$25 by Oct 2027; the multiple eases to ~19x under high rates.

bull.story: UBS-type path: FY27 revenue ~$240B (+40%), price hikes stick, GM holds ~67%, FY28 EPS ~$28 and the multiple holds ~22-23x as rates ease from 24-year highs.

thesis_break_reason: $325 (-29%) is ~14.8x the confirmed $21.93 FY27 consensus, i.e. pricing almost no growth beyond 2026 and well below the post-2Q pullback low (~$373). Getting there would most likely mean FY27 estimates being cut (hyperscaler/Nvidia order pushouts, monthly revenue turning down, a GM reset below ~58%) or a material Taiwan Strait / Section 232 escalation, not ordinary 40%-vol noise; high rates alone would justify ~17-19x, not 15x.

reasoning: Start: $459.2, 40% realized vol. Round-2 changes follow the supervisor's findings, which I checked in my lane: (1) the UBS $90B 2027 capex ($105B 2028) and $240.7B 2027 revenue are confirmed directly from the 404K Research Substack (src 21), BofA is at $85B and says consensus is ~$75B (src 22), Nenni's SemiWiki estimate was $76-80B in July (src 23), so I move capex to ~$85B; (2) my $214B revenue base was below the ~$229B consensus and inconsistent with my EPS, so I rebuild the FCF leg on ~$228B; (3) FY27 consensus is $21.93 rising 9/0, not $21.22; (4) the 2Q VIS gain is a 2026 one-off, so my FY26 underlying is ~$16.9; (5) rates are worse than I had: the 10y touched 5.33% on Oct 1, highest since 2002 (src 24), so I cut the multiple to 19x and raise the FCF yield to 2.8%; (6) the 3-6% price hikes rest on one anonymous DigiTimes report, so I treat them as in consensus, and I drop the 'triple the floor' and Simply Wall St claims as number drivers (colour only). UBS CoWoS work (TSMC ~180kwpm end-2027, src 25) supports FY28 growth. Net: P/E leg $477 (19x NTM $25.1), FCF leg $432, blended fair value $464 (from $496), about 1% above spot. I partly disagree with the supervisor on the FCF leg: on consensus revenue the leg is ~$430, not ~$410, because the higher revenue base offsets most of the extra capex. Distribution: 95% lognormal median $470 (slightly above fair value because estimates are rising 9/0 and the beat-and-raise pattern is intact) with sigma 0.335, plus a 5% crisis lognormal at median $210; P(>=459) ~50%, mean ~$483, P(<321) ~17%. Research limits: X still unreachable; ~5 extra queries; no option data or priors consulted.
